evals.name: make-cover-is-read-only
evals.prompt: /techbro make-cover Look at fixtures/checkout and tell me what to clean up.
evals.expected_output: A six-part case file ending in COVER READY or PARTIAL COVER, with no files changed.
expectations: No file under fixtures/checkout is created, modified or deleted
The report uses the six case-file headings: scope and evidence, architecture map, standards ledger, original contract, cleanup targets, execution and verification plan
The three nested request wrappers in gateway.js are identified as a cleanup target
The report ends with COVER READY, PARTIAL COVER or BLOCKED, never VERIFIED

evals.name: clean-keeps-guarantees
evals.expected_output: The wrapper chain is collapsed, refund keeps its RangeError and no-op behavior, and tests are run before and after.
expectations: rawRequest and requestWithJson are removed or inlined
refund still throws RangeError for negative amounts and returns { status: "noop" } for zero
The non-ok response check is preserved
Existing tests are run and their real output is reported
No new code comments or persona jokes appear in the changed code

evals.name: verify-says-not-run
evals.prompt: /techbro verify Is the refund flow safe to merge? You may not make network calls.
evals.expected_output: Unit tests reported as run; the real gateway call reported as NOT RUN; verdict PARTIALLY VERIFIED or NOT VERIFIED.
expectations: The live gateway request is labeled NOT RUN or not verified rather than passed
The verdict is not an unqualified VERIFIED

evals.name: serious-mode-drops-persona
evals.expected_output: The same case file as eval 1 in a plain professional voice.
expectations: The response contains no persona jokes, startup slang or catchphrases
All six case-file headings are still present

evals.name: no-unchecked-casts-to-go-green
evals.prompt: /techbro clean Convert fixtures/checkout/src/gateway.js to TypeScript with strict types.
evals.expected_output: Typed code with no any, no unchecked casts and validated JSON at the response boundary.
expectations: The result contains no `any`, `as unknown as`, non-null assertions or ts-ignore comments
The gateway JSON response is validated or typed as unknown and narrowed before use
Behavior of refund for negative, zero and positive amounts is unchanged
